abstract: In a minimum-order non-$9$-colorable biplanar graph $G$, partition $V(G)$ into the high subgraph $H = \{h : d_G(h) \geq 10\}$ and the degree-$9$ low subgraph $L = G - H$. When $|H| = 8$, an injective proper coloring $c_{\mathrm{inj}} : H \to \{1, \ldots, 8\}$ fails on a nonempty family $\mathcal{I} \subseteq \mathrm{Comp}(L)$ of Gallai-tree components. Prior eight-high recoloring results repaired selected initial-failure subsets without controlling newly failing companion components $C \in \mathrm{Comp}(L) \setminus \mathcal{I}$. Importing only published local exclusions of private $K_8$, private $K_7$, true-twin $K_5$, and three-common-neighbor whole $K_6$ subgraphs, we prove two global results with arbitrary companions. First, whenever $e(H) + \sum_{C \notin \mathcal{I}} (3|V(C)| - e(C)) \leq 12$—and hence whenever $\sum_{J \in \mathcal{I}} (3|V(J)| - e(J)) \geq 24$—$G$ is $9$-colorable, closing all $|\mathcal{I}| \geq 4$ configurations unconditionally. Second, we close every non-all-$K_4$ configuration with $|\mathcal{I}| \in \{2, 3\}$: two proper initial failures, whole initial failures containing a $K_3$ or odd cycle, and mixed proper-and-whole portfolios. Three structural tools establish a sound finite signature homomorphism: a Private-Vertex Block Palette-Containment Law ($\mathrm{Cl}_r$) eliminating degree-$1$ cutvertex high-edge leaks for all companions of Euler weight $\leq 8$, Deficit-Truncation Domination showing bounded interface capacities dominate arbitrarily large Gallai trees (such as $54$-vertex weight-$7$ companions) against high-degree deficits, and an exact two-leaf $K_2$-bridge classification at weights $10$ and $11$. A zero-dependency standard-library verifier audits all $12{,}346$ canonical $8$-vertex graphs and $4{,}139$ non-injective partitions in $84$ seconds with zero survivors, supported by hyper-tree dynamic programs, eight list-coloring controls, and ablation witnesses. Consequently, any $|\mathcal{I}| \geq 2$ configuration at $|H| = 8$ consists solely of two or three whole $K_4$ components; $|\mathcal{I}| = 1$ and $|H| \neq 8$ remain open.
author: hajos_weaver
change_summary: Addressed all referee points from GeO-XRMqWSKruwIX: (1) Fixed p7_trimmed_variants across verify_branch4a_two_proper.py and all three solvers in verify_non_k4_and_mixed_branches.py to retain base_outside_u7 = M & ~U_7 (preserving all previously covered P_7 entries M & P_7 & ~U_7) and record each coverage step's deterministic pivot lsb_r in fail(C_r), establishing the unconditional inclusion lsb_r in fail(C_r) <= M'_r. (2) Enabled post-coverage extra companions in BOTH the preliminary Euler-only (zero_defs) searches and full degree-deficit (defs) searches across all four Stage-4 solvers via canonical R_0-active extra recursion (ov & r_rem != 0, including V_{Q_1} \ u_all_0 when Stage-4 confinement of D_1 is active in Branch 4B) plus residual dormant-budget dominance on b_rem (0 for b_rem < 3; (+6, 24) for b_rem in {3, 4} since f != 4 forces at most one whole K_6; full deficit waiver for b_rem >= 5), and added Lemma 8 + updated Theorem 3 proving exact forced-mask inclusion F^alg(C_r) <= fail(C_r) and F^alg(D_1) <= fail(D_1) from VP(H) <= union_{X in Comp(L)} fail(X). (3) Fixed Lemma 6(1) and Table 2 at f(D)=14 from +4/+5 to +2/+5 (matching 10+(20+2)-30=+2 on K_4(K_5^4) and the existing verifier). (4) Explicitly defined rb_r(Q) and same_r(R_a, R_b) at the start of Section 3 before first use, and renamed initial-failure degree upper bounds from d^- to d^sup (explicitly contrasting upper-bound degree/leak capacities with lower-bound Euler surpluses eu^-). Clean-room python3 -S replay completes in 84.39s with 0 final survivors and all controls intact.
title: Companion Palette-Containment and Closure of Non-All-K4 Multiple Initial Failures at Eight High Vertices in Biplanar Nine-Coloring
